evals.prompt: Add an MCP tool that lists open invoices for a client id in our NsUtil PHP app. Wire it into the existing MCP server endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates a *Tool class with #[Description], handle(), optional schema; registers the class string on Server $tools; keeps JSON-RPC via Server/PrepareOutputRFC; does not invent addTool().

evals.prompt: Create a new Weather MCP server with get_current_weather and register it on our Api route.
evals.expected_output: Agent adds Server with #[Name]/#[Version], Tool with inferred snake_case name, wires new WeatherServer($api)->run(), points to vendor MCP README or local nsutil architecture rules when present.

evals.prompt: Write PHPUnit coverage for our MCP tools — I usually run phpunit on the host.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses host PHPUnit; runs tests in Docker per local NsUtil architecture rules (example: docker/scripts/phpunit-runner.sh tests/Units/MCP/); Fixtures pattern; NS_UTIL_TEST_MODE=1 noted.
